correctness.rationale: For exactly three strategic agents in arbitrary metric and two facilities at reported sites, omission weight δ_i^-α has strategyproofness iff 0<=α<=3. Reconstructed reduction h=d(x_i,r_i')<truthful cost c<=d/2; otherwise every realized facility distance already >=c. An initially distant agent yields (1+t)^α(1-(1+S)t)<=1 for S>=2, α<=3. For close-pair agents proof partitions into postdeviation close-pair with b<=1+2h, close-pair with b>=1+2h using positive derivative, and new distant member with exact clearing-denominators polynomial P(h,v)>=0 for 0<=v<=1. Independent sympy expansion reproduced EVERY coefficient of that polynomial, including cross terms; negative coefficient groups are bounded nonnegative. For α>3, profile (0,1,2), leftmost report -ε gives derivative 2(3-α)/9<0, independently differentiated. Inspected actual verify.py: exact 4096 labeled 4-point metric closures with each of 4 powers, three deviators, four sites (=196608 checks), plus symbolic identity and α4 witness; these finite checks do not establish continuum theorem.
